market.question: Will there be 6 or more major space weather events this week?

assessment.reasoning: Resolution counts G3+/S3+/R3+ events between May 3-9 2026. Recent week showed only G1 storming and isolated R1 blackouts; no G3-class events. Even at solar max, 6+ severe events in one week is rare; this would require extreme solar activity not currently forecast.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Any unexpected M-X class flare cluster from AR4420/4425 could cause cascading events.
